arms.band: per-band CRC floor thresholds, max-min S*, leftover spent globally
arms.global: one threshold at the OOF (1-R) score quantile (status quo)

cost_reported_with_endpoint: under-40 referral rate, band - global (paired CI)
all-ages referral rate, band - global (paired CI) -- the nominal budget is fit on OOF and the realised rate on reserved is measured, not assumed
evaluation: manifest_v4 split=reserved (4,733 images, 104 under-40 escalating lesions); frozen V1 predictions (S13 + S54 top-up); read once
floor_transfer_check: per fitted band, realised reserved system sensitivity with its interval against the nominal OOF floor S*; 'violated' when the interval's upper bound is below S*
model: frozen V1: 6-CNN uniform soft-vote, 24-view TTA, deployed HAM-OOF Dirichlet (research/selective/results_oof/fit_state.json); S54 outcome 4 keeps it
not_done: S55 per-band calibration is not adopted here: the deployed global map is held fixed so the contrast isolates the abstention rule
per_budget_columns: nnb at pi 0.01/0.03/0.05 (upper bound: every referral counted as a biopsy)

primary_endpoint.interval: lesion-grouped paired bootstrap (group_id), one resample for both arms, 2000 draws, seed 42

outcomes.POSITIVE_BELOW_MCID: CI lower bound > 0 and delta < MCID
outcomes.SUPPORTED: delta >= MCID and CI lower bound > 0

primary_endpoint.quantity: under-40 system escalation sensitivity, band arm minus global arm, at R = 0.2, same score, reserved

proportion_intervals: research.stats.intervals.proportion (Clopper-Pearson below 30 events, lesion-grouped bootstrap otherwise)
referral_semantics: a referred case is not a silent miss; system sensitivity = (argmax-escalated or referred) / escalating; FRR = 1 - that

score_selection.rule:
The rule, declared before val was scored (and restated in the plan):

    Among the four scores, under the **band** arm, pick the highest val **all-ages** system
    escalation sensitivity averaged over the five budgets -- all-ages because val has 22
    under-40 escalating cases and S48 retires <=25-positive quantities from any decision --
    among scores whose mean retained Macro-F1 is within ``F1_NONINFERIORITY`` of the best
    score's. Ties (to 1e-9) go to the earlier name in ``SCORES``.

secondary_descriptive.why: highest val system sensitivity but fails the Macro-F1 guard, so not selected; its reserved frontier and <40 band-global contrast are reported beside the primary and decide nothing

title: Group-conditional selective abstention (per-age-band referral thresholds)
